entry.title: Meetup recap
entry.content:
Forty creatures came to the June meetup at the ranger station, and Beaver gave the talk everyone wanted: how to lint a dam.

Details

Beaver showed how Squatch Lint checks a config before it's used, Owl answered questions until well after dark, and Raccoon asked whether the snacks were cached. (They were not. They were eaten.) Every release makes Squatch Lint a little faster, and the next meetup is on the Cedar trail.
